items.title: Is Invesco (IVZ) Below Fair Value After Its ETF Push?
items.summary: Invesco has delivered a 135.0% return over the past three years, which puts fresh attention on a basic question. Is the current share price consistent with the returns the asset manager earns on the capital it deploys into its business? A 135.0% gain over three years puts meaningful pressure on the idea that Invesco's market value and the returns it earns on its capital are moving in step.
